maps-resolutions.note: Resolution cache for the Google Maps links the carriers publish, keyed by the link itself: the final URL the redirect landed on, the coordinate extracted from it and which tier produced it (inline | redirect | place-dms | static-map | cid-pin | unresolved). Coordinates only; no map tiles, imagery or place records are stored.
